'''Sniffing''' is the ability to "smell" where violence has occurred. The strength of the smell depends on the severity of the violence; the smell of a murder will last much longer than the smell of a petty robbery. Sniffing is a very rare ability. Many rulers have ''sniffers'', though they keep them secret.

In [[The Great Hunt]], [[Hurin]] is a ''sniffer'' who is enlisted by [[Ingtar]] to help track [[Padan Fain]] and the [[Darkfriends]] and [[Trollocs]] who have taken the [[Horn of Valere]]. During their trek many find that Perrin has a similar sense of smell so to keep his cover he says he is an apprentice to Hurin.
